name: sample-rows
description:
N rows of the table, or a share of them, chosen at random; the rows keep their order.

A share is rounded to the nearest whole number of rows. An n larger than the table keeps every row. The same seed chooses the same rows each run; without a seed each run chooses anew. Give n or share, one of them.

n: how many rows to keep.
share: the share of the rows to keep, above 0 up to 1.
seed: a whole number that makes the choice the same each run.

Example: semkit read freq.csv sample-rows --n 2 --seed 1 write -
-> диван купить, 10; купить диван, 8

The step changes no cell. The working column stays the same.

options.name: --share
options.description: the share of the rows to keep, above 0 up to 1.

options.name: --seed
options.description: a whole number that makes the choice the same each run.
